# Goobers v0.5.1

This patch backports the intervention request-budget fix from #7520 to the
v0.5 stable line.

## Fixes

- Build with Go 1.26.10 to address vulnerabilities reported against the stable
  line's previous Go 1.26.6 toolchain, including GO-2026-6809.
- Update `golang.org/x/net` to v0.60.0 to address the corresponding HTTP/2
  vulnerabilities in that dependency.
- Approve, override, rerun-stage, and escalation resolution now allow enough
  time for the engine's durable human-in-the-loop decision: 65 seconds on the
  server and 70 seconds in the CLI. Ordinary mutation timeouts are unchanged.
- Claim reacquisition observes request cancellation and returns an actionable
  `claims_lock_timeout` response when contention exhausts its wait budget.
- Engine intervention delivery observes the admission request's cancellation
  rather than continuing under the daemon execution context.

## Operator guidance

After an intervention timeout, do not immediately retry: an already submitted
Temporal update may still complete. Wait at least 70 seconds, then inspect
`goobers status <instance-root>` or the run journal. Retry only if the run still
reports `waiting_for_gate` and no approval/resume record exists.

No DSL support-policy changes are introduced in this patch.
